title: feat(spec)!: retire emailAndPassword.revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset — a completed password reset always ends every session the account holds
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBY61hHdLdFdzwXbxaNtv58y)_

Fixes #29909

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset -- skills` has 0 hits at the base and at the head; no published skill teaches the key.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：认证配置里的 `emailAndPassword.revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset` 退役为墓碑键：写它（无论 `true` 还是 `false`）在 `tsc`、schema 解析和 plugin-auth 启动/配置补丁入口都会被拒，提示「删掉这个键」。重置密码后吊销该账号全部会话的行为不变。
- **为什么改**：按卡上裁决「一律吊销,不加开关」与「第三批 同意」。#29827 落地后这个键只剩一个合法值，按 ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove 退役。
- **风险与回滚**：仓内没有任何生产者写这个键（只有测试写过 `true`，已改）；外部仍写 `true` 的宿主配置会在启动时被拒，删键即可。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/password-reset-ends-sessions.ts`（守卫从「只拒 false」改为「任何值都拒」）、`packages/spec/src/system/auth-config.zod.ts`（墓碑和导出的处方常量）、`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.email-and-password-revoke-sessions-on-reset-retired.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project repo src/system/auth-revoke-sessions-on-password-reset-retirement.test.ts`，预期 15 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`.** `EmailAndPasswordConfig.revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset` becomes `retiredKey(REVOKE_SESSIONS_ON_PASSWORD_RESET_RETIRED)`. The prescription reads: "`emailAndPassword.revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset` was removed in @objectstack/spec 18 (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove) — it could hold only one value: a completed password reset always ends every session the account holds, on every reset door, and no setting turns that off. Delete the key; nothing replaces it." It is exported from `@objectstack/spec/system` so plugin-auth answers with the same text.
- **The comment above the key** (the #14478 ruling B `externalVocabulary` example) no longer cites this key; it now lists the live siblings plugin-auth still forwards by name (`disableSignUp`, `requireEmailVerification`, `minPasswordLength`, `maxPasswordLength`, `autoSignIn`).
- **ADR-0087.** `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` gains `system/EmailAndPasswordConfig:revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset`; a D3 semantic entry `email-and-password-revoke-sessions-on-reset-retired` and its `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment (order 118). No D2 conversion: the key lives in host plugin configuration, not in a stack collection or a stored row (the `AccessControlConfig.maxAge` precedent). The prescription therefore carries no `os migrate meta` sentence.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-auth`.** `assertPasswordResetEndsSessions` is kept and re-aimed, not deleted: it now refuses the retired key at ANY value (it refused only `false`), throwing `[auth] ` + the spec prescription, at construction and on `applyConfigPatch`. `auth-manager-auth-instance.ts` still sets better-auth's own `revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset: true`: that line is the mechanism of the rule, not a forward of the spec key (comment updated to say so).
- **Docs.** `docs/HARDENING.md` (the revocation row and the step-3 check) and `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` now say the behaviour is unconditional and the key is retired. Regenerated: `authorable-surface/system.json` (`[RETIRED]` row), `api-surface/system.json` and `export-origins/system.json` (the new export), `content/docs/references/system/auth-config.mdx`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/29909-revoke-sessions-on-password-reset-retired.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/plugin-auth` minor, marker `registered email-and-password-revoke-sessions-on-reset-retired`, BREAKING banner and the remedy.

## Why

The maintainer ruled on #29909, verbatim: 「一律吊销,不加开关」 and 「第三批 同意」 (item 2: retire the key). After #29827 the key could hold one value only.

Premise checks at base `21510bba` (main, after #29827 merged as `3a856f68`):

- `git grep -n revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset -- packages docs skills content examples ui`: the schema key, the two writers of `true` the card names (`auth-manager.test.ts:2060`, `auth-config.test.ts:299`), the plugin guard and its tests, the better-auth option at `auth-manager-auth-instance.ts:390`, `docs/HARDENING.md:263`, and one more prose producer the card did not list: `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx:313`. At the head, every remaining hit is the tombstone, the exported prescription, the plugin guard and its refusal tests, the better-auth option, generated references, the D3 entry, and released `CHANGELOG.md` history.
- **`assertPasswordResetEndsSessions` is NOT unreachable after the tombstone** (the order's condition for deleting it fails): `AuthManager` never parses its configuration through `AuthConfigSchema` (plugin-auth has no parse of it; `one-time-token-handoff.ts` says so), so an untyped host or an `applyConfigPatch` caller still reaches it. Re-aimed instead, as spec seat 2 agreed in thread.
- Overlap: GitHub search of open PRs for `revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset`, `EmailAndPasswordConfig`, `assertPasswordResetEndsSessions` and "password reset": 0 hits each. That search reads PR text, not file lists.

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/system/auth-revoke-sessions-on-password-reset-retirement.test.ts` (repo project, listed in `vitest.repo-tests.json`): the prescription text; refusal of `true`, `false`, `'false'`, `0`, `null`, `{}` at the key with code `invalid_type`, path and exact message; the nested path through `AuthConfigSchema`; CONTROL without the key and with `undefined`; the `tsc` channel (`@ts-expect-error`); the walked shape keeps the key; registration (retired-key row, D3 entry with no `conversionIds`, no D2 names the key); a tree-scoped absence walk over the declared `@objectstack/spec` radius with a lit control. 15/15.
- `auth-config.test.ts`: the "full config" case no longer writes the key and asserts the parse grows none.
- plugin-auth `password-reset-ends-sessions.test.ts`: refusal at construction for `false`, `true`, `'false'`, `0`, `null`; on a patch for `false` and `true` with the standing configuration kept; the message equals the spec prescription; CONTROL: absent, `undefined` and no block pass. `auth-manager.test.ts`: the forwarding case no longer writes the key and asserts better-auth still receives `revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset: true`.

<details><summary>Ablation (tombstone refusal)</summary>

Mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages/spec/src/system/auth-config.zod.ts` at `6c320a30`: anchor `revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset: retiredKey(REVOKE_SESSIONS_ON_PASSWORD_RESET_RETIRED),` → `revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset: z.boolean().optional() /* ablated-29909 */,` (anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1, blob `6336afb7` → `3666d8f9`). No build leg: the pin imports `./auth-config.zod` from source, not through a `dist/`.

- Retirement pin: **9 failed | 6 passed (15)**. Red: the six value refusals, the nested `AuthConfigSchema` refusal, the `tsc` channel (the parse no longer throws), and the absence walk (the ablated declaration is itself a key-position write without `retiredKey(`).
- Restored by the tool: blob after restore `6336afb7` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

Run serially at `6c320a30`; five first reads were not green and each was re-run: `check:comment-mask-adoption` exit 1 (a real finding: the absence walk had a private comment stripper; fixed in `2d3b20f5` by importing `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`, then exit 0); `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3 (shallow clone; fetched its pinned fixture commit, then exit 0); `check:exported-any`, `check:skill-examples` exit 3 and `check:generated` exit 1 (read a spec `dist` older than its inputs while `test:repo` was regenerating; after a spec rebuild all exit 0). `dispatch-gates --ran`: **108 derived, 108 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**.

## Acceptance notes

- The order said to delete `assertPasswordResetEndsSessions` if unreachable; it is reachable (above), so it was kept and now refuses `true` too. That makes the plugin-auth half a further narrowing of #29827's released "`true` is accepted", stated in the changeset.
- The order named "any forward of the key in `auth-manager-auth-instance.ts`": there is none. The `revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset: true` there is better-auth's own option and stays; the absence walk excludes that file with the reason written beside it.
- `docs/HARDENING.md` had two references to the behaviour (row 263 and the step-3 comment), not three; both updated.
- No liveness ledger row exists for `EmailAndPasswordConfig` (auth configuration is not a walked metadata type), so `check:liveness` has nothing to re-grade.
